feature_contract.goal: Restore OutRun's original D3D9 GPU bindings and report private right-eye RT/depth/viewport/c64 state-restore faults on both R84 R30 XYZRHW and R33 fast-world/HUD paths instead of silently returning native LEFT success.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original game render-state rollback after R84 private-eye draws and exact-HUD source-change c64 restore. Do not change standalone RIGHT GPU Draw error policy, replay LEFT, widen lens/HUD admission, alter input/FFB/SkyGlow or touch R26_SAFE, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Confirmed source-level missing HRESULT propagation: R30 and R33 marked current stereo frame invalid and armed mono safety after failed original render-state restore yet returned the prior successful native LEFT Draw; R33 HUD exact producer-change c64 rollback also returned LEFT success on failed restore.
trace_stages: Original game HUD/XYZRHW/world geometry enters R84 R30 or R33, submits one actual native LEFT Draw then private RIGHT GPU state and draw.
R30/R33 restore the original game RT/depth/viewport/c64 bindings after RIGHT, while a distinct exact HUD source-changed branch restores original c64 without dispatching RIGHT.
Failed restore now propagates an HRESULT error while keeping existing right-eye frame validity veto and preventing any duplicate native LEFT Draw.
subcomponents: R30 native XYZRHW original world and HUD stereo path propagates failed private-eye RT/depth/viewport restoration.
R33 native fast-world and HUD shader stereo paths propagate failed original RT/depth/viewport/c64 restoration.
R33 HUD exact producer-source change after native LEFT propagates failed original c64 rollback, but successful rollback retains original game HRESULT.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: R30 and R33 original-game render state restore failure is propagated after the native left GPU submission with right-eye failure safety maintained.
Preserve original native left errors, right-only eye failure safety, shader/queue admission, Reset, original input/FFB, SkyGlow and R26 safe fallback.
Source result exact SHA must pass DX9Ex Active game/host/R26 rollback package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact; Quest3 validation stays untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Prepatch R84 R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo, R33TryFastWorld, R33TryHud and R33 source-change rollback explicitly detected restore failure yet returned the original native left success.
diagnosis.root_cause: GPU state-restoration fault was recorded for stereo frame recovery but was not propagated to the original game's calling HRESULT, allowing a successful call return with corrupted game D3D9 render state.
source_trace: Original game projected screen/world draws flow into R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo and then private right-eye RT, depth and viewport setters.
R33TryFastWorld and R33TryHud submit native left draw then private right-eye RT, depth, viewport and shader c64 setters before game-state restoration.
R33TryHud exact source-change rejection separately restores original c64 after native left but had not reported failure when original c64 setter failed.
alternatives_rejected: Do not propagate right-only GPU Draw errors as original game's LEFT Draw failure or repeat the native left submission; existing stereo frame veto is independent.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Source-proven native LEFT remains single submission; RIGHT-only GPU faults invalidate stereo frame while original state restore errors propagate. Physical Quest3 binocular result remains unknown.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Shared R30StateRestore typed HRESULT decision applied to R30 XYZRHW and R33 fast-world/HUD state restoration including exact HUD source-change c64 rollback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++ static_assert verifies success, negative original draw, positive nonzero success, original render state restore errors, successful source-change rollback, and right-only eye Draw status separation.
